# dbdiagramr

dbdiagramr is a free, open-source web tool that generates interactive entity-relationship (ER) diagrams from any PostgreSQL connection string. No signup, no setup — paste your connection string and visualize your database schema in under 10 seconds.

## Key pages

- Home: https://dbdiagramr.space
- Visualize your database: https://dbdiagramr.space/visualize
- Schema diagram library: https://dbdiagramr.space/schema
- Pricing: https://dbdiagramr.space/pricing.md
- Features: https://dbdiagramr.space#features
- How it works: https://dbdiagramr.space#guide

## Schema diagram library

Reference ER diagrams of popular PostgreSQL schemas, each showing every table, column, primary key, and foreign key relationship:

- Supabase auth schema (7 tables): https://dbdiagramr.space/schema/supabase
- NextAuth.js / Auth.js schema (4 tables): https://dbdiagramr.space/schema/nextauth
- Laravel 11 default schema (7 tables): https://dbdiagramr.space/schema/laravel
- Django auth schema (9 tables): https://dbdiagramr.space/schema/django

## Pricing

- Free: $0/month — 5 diagrams per month, static PNG export, single database connection
- Pro: $8/month — unlimited diagrams, interactive shareable links, version history, team access (up to 5 members), priority support

## About

- Generates interactive entity-relationship diagrams from live PostgreSQL schemas
- Renders on an interactive canvas with pan, zoom, and hover-to-trace table relationships
- Exports diagrams as SVG or PNG
- Works with cloud databases: Supabase, Neon, Railway
- Uses the Transaction pooler (port 6543) for serverless platform compatibility
- Connection strings are never stored — introspected and discarded immediately
- Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Tailwind CSS
- Last updated: 2026-08-03
